name: SEP Analytical (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: SEP Analytical (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. provides third-party testing services in China. The company offers testing fields, such as environment, solid waste, agricultural products, food, consumer goods, occupational health, and medicine, as well as environmental sampling and remediation. It also provides services such as environmental remediation, saline-alkali land improvement, technical consulting, AI information services, environmental damage judicial appraisal, and robot inspection, providing ESG sustainable solutions for end customers.
